reviews.text: Great service. Excellent customer service and they always provide themed photos. Highly recommended.

Llao’s Pet is definitely my dog’s favorite place! 🐶💗 Ever since we arrived, they’ve always treated him incredibly well, and you can really see the love, patience, and care they have for the dogs. The best part is that he always comes in super happy and excited, and that, for me, is the best sign that he feels safe and happy there. 🥰

Every time I bathe him, I can choose from different shampoos with delicious scents, and he always comes out smelling amazing and super clean. They also give him a paw spa, which I love because they not only care about making him look good, but also about pampering him and taking care of every detail. 🐾✨

His haircut always turns out great. You can tell they have experience and take great care with each dog because they always respect our requests, and he comes out looking so handsome. Plus, when he stays for his Deluxe Spa, they take these gorgeous photos that I love because I can see how much fun he’s having while he’s there. 📸🐶

And something he absolutely loves is his massage 🥹💆🏻‍♂️ He always thoroughly enjoys that moment of relaxation and pampering, and I love knowing that besides leaving clean and handsome, he also leaves relaxed and happy.

For me, it's super important to leave my dog ​​in a place where I know he'll be treated with love and patience, and at Llao's Pet, I've definitely found that. You can tell they truly love what they do and that each dog receives special attention and care.

We've been taking our beloved Nina there for a while now, and we always leave happy.

Great service and friendly staff.

Oscar, my dog, is always so happy to come for his bath and haircut. I get so excited every time I see how he looks after his haircut! I highly recommend this place and the staff is always so friendly.

Don't take them there... they'll HURT them! They employed a guy named Sebastian... he cut my dog's nails and left five of them BLEEDING, and all badly cut because he just does it haphazardly and without looking. I even explained to him how I wanted my dog's nails cut once, and he explained it to the person who cut them, and he cut them backwards! The hair grows back, but the pain and bleeding he caused my dog ​​is unforgivable. That Sebastian is a disgrace to that place.
Super professional and gentle with the dogs. Highly recommended, they always make my dog ​​look gorgeous and without any damage. ♡

It was our trusted vet until I told them my dog ​​had a serious health issue and that they should be careful.
They injured his elbow, causing a wound, and didn't trim his nails, so he got caught in something while playing, bled, and hurt himself. They didn't tell me they hadn't trimmed them.
They refunded me for the elbow treatment, but they didn't notify me about the nail issue, so I had to go to another vet for that.
The kids are super friendly and treat the boundaries with so much love. I love that they take pictures of them with the month's theme and in bathrobes 🫶🏼. …

Highly recommend them, they're so kind!

I'm always looking for the best places to take Nina, my dog. Honestly, I've been coming to Llaos Pet for over a year now and I'm so happy! The service is excellent from the moment I drop her off! They even use a special shampoo for her hair! They give her little massages when they're finished and even take pictures according to the theme of the month!!! Wow!

You can tell they treat our dogs with kindness and patience! And another thing I want to highlight is that you can watch them cut her hair from outside! ❤️🫶🏼
Finding places like this is like gold! That's why I'm sharing it with complete honesty! 10/10
Thank you for taking such good care of Nina and making her look so beautiful!
They even gave her a treat 👏🏻🙌🏼 (they asked me beforehand)
🙌🏼
